base_definition: LIQUID-RANDOM-50, derived from the bars panel, never stored. Draw date D = the first XNYS session of each calendar month; holdings for every session t are the draw dated D(t) = the first session of t's month. Eligible on D, using ONLY bars dated strictly before D: median close x volume over the last LIQUID_DV_SESSIONS sessions >= LIQUID_MIN_DOLLAR_VOL; last close >= LIQUID_MIN_PRICE taken from a REAL bar on the last session before D (no forward fill for eligibility: a name without a bar on that session is ineligible, which also satisfies LIQUID_MAX_BAR_AGE); >= LIQUID_MIN_HISTORY real bars; no SUSPECT_CORPORATE_ACTION in the last LIQUID_SUSPECT_LOOKBACK sessions (discovery_autopsy's rule: a one-bar raw move, last real bar to next real bar, above AUTOPSY_SUSPECT_UP or below AUTOPSY_SUSPECT_DOWN on a name whose previous close is >= AUTOPSY_MIN_PRICE); not an ETF or index proxy (LIQUID_EXCLUDE_ETFS: xs_ranker.INDEX_PROXIES + llm_portfolio.is_etf). Eligible symbols are sorted and LIQUID_N are drawn by paper_books._draw (np.random.default_rng, without replacement) with seed int(sha256('LIQUID_SEED:D')[:8], 16), recorded on every draw. Equal weight at D's close (the fill), then held as shares (drifting) until the next draw; a draw re-targets at its D's close. Costs: the engine's standard 5 + 1 bps per side. FORWARD: the first FORWARD row of each month RECORDS the draw (seed, pool, pool_sha16, names, D, last bar used) in the append-only draws.jsonl; every later step and grade of that month uses the recorded basket and refuses (DRAW_MISMATCH) when a re-derivation from the current panel gives a different pool hash, unless --accept-recorded-draw, which proceeds on the recorded basket and records that it did. The BACKFILL replay re-derives every month and prints each pool hash.
carry_rule: A held name with no new bar is carried at its last real close (forward fill for MARKING only), flagged per day on the receipt, and counts toward the stale-weight refusal once its newest bar is more than STALE_BAR_SESSIONS sessions old. Direction of the bias: UPWARD for a failure (the true exit is below the last close), roughly NEUTRAL for a cash acquisition (the last close is near the deal price), and IDENTICAL for the overlay and its twin (both carry the same names), so it moves both lines and not their difference except through the scalar.

comparison_base.role: COMPARISON ONLY, never graded: the same scalars applied to SPY alone (scalar x SPY vs 1.0 x SPY), so the overlay's effect can be read on the index too

costs: one-way rate = (COST_BPS_PER_SIDE + SLIPPAGE_BPS) / 1e4 on every traded dollar, including the overlay's own scalar turnover; cash earns 0

disclosure.objects_looked_at_note: 3 = two graded bases tried ($3M random draw, LIQUID-RANDOM-50) plus the SPY comparison base whose replay was seen
disclosure.seen_before_choosing: the range of the per-run source-weighted tone input (about -0.21 .. +0.05 over 2026-09-29..11-11) had been seen before SLOPE and DEADBAND were chosen; no return of any kind had been seen
disclosure.v2_change: only the baseline-age bound and the forward-path fixes; chosen by a reviewer's correctness finding, not from replay returns
disclosure.v3_change: only the base (and the stale-bar flag becoming a refusal). The tone->scalar rule (SLOPE, DEADBAND, STEP, bounds, MIN_THEMES, BASELINE_N/MIN/MAX_AGE_DAYS, timing) is v2's, unchanged. Base choice is a SECOND LOOK at this design: bases tried = 2 (the $3M random draw, then LIQUID-RANDOM-50); tone mappings tried = 1 functional form with one parameter set (v2's MAPPINGS_TRIED = 2 counts the v2 baseline-age bound as a second variant and is kept). The v2 replay had been seen (overlay -0.84 pp vs twin) before v3 was declared; the v3 base was chosen for readability (stale bars, splits, small caps), not from that number, and its seed was declared in config before any v3 replay ran
disclosure.v4_change: no mapping or base-rule parameter changed; eligibility now needs a real bar on the last session before D (no forward fill), the forward draw is recorded and checked, a stale panel refuses, and the wording above was added

grading: only FORWARD rows of this policy_hash; a session with no row -> scalar 1.0, reason NO_DECISION_ROW (never the last scalar held); a session where a base holding's last real bar is more than STALE_BAR_SESSIONS sessions old is also marked DEGRADED on the grade and the holdings are listed

inputs.base_holdings: derived, never stored: LIQUID-RANDOM-50 from OPTIMUS_LEDGER_DIR/prices_2025_26/bars.parquet (close, volume) dated strictly before each monthly draw date
inputs.digests: OPTIMUS_LEDGER_DIR/digest/world_digest_<YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>.json (world_digest.out_dir); fields themes[].tone.fear_greed and themes[].tone.n_independent_sources; dry runs ignored

licence: PRODUCT_EXPERIMENT (internal simulation only: no broker, no order, no LLM authority)
mapping: F = sum_i n_i * fear_greed_i / sum_i n_i over themes with numeric tone.fear_greed, n_i = max(1, n_independent_sources); fewer than MIN_THEMES -> EMPTY. B = median F over the previous BASELINE_N valid digests stamped strictly before this digest AND no more than BASELINE_MAX_AGE_DAYS older than it; fewer than BASELINE_MIN -> NO_BASELINE. d = F - B; raw = 1 - SLOPE * max(0, -d - DEADBAND); scalar = clip(round(raw / STEP) * STEP, SCALAR_MIN, SCALAR_MAX). Any degradation -> 1.0.
name: NEWS_OVERLAY_v4
objective: terminal NAV of the overlay vs its twin under the BALANCED personality (same notional, same costs); read daily, by date block, raw lines first
rebalance: a book re-targets at a session close only when its scalar changed or the base book's holdings changed (a base rebalance dated on a non-session day takes effect at the first session after it); otherwise it holds its shares
recorded_draw: draws.jsonl beside decisions.jsonl, append-only, one DRAW row per month written with that month's first FORWARD row; ACCEPTED_RECORDED_DRAW rows record every --accept-recorded-draw use with the pool diff
replay_finding: Finding from the v3 BACKFILL replay (20261112T175256Z), stated and NOT fixed (the mapping was declared before any replay and stays as declared): on the five days the scalar was below 1.0 (2026-10-01 0.7, 10-02 0.5, 10-08 0.95, 10-09 0.6, 10-14 0.95) SPY's next sessions were +0.74%, +0.67%, +0.60%, -0.06%, +0.28%: the overlay cut exposure into rebounds (reviewer's count: -0.67 pp missed, about $115 extra cost on the SPY comparison). On 2026-11-04 the digest was EMPTY, so the scalar was 1.0 into the -4.4% SPY session of 2026-11-05: the overlay never had the chance to help on the one day that mattered. An EMPTY digest is the overlay's blind spot: it holds full exposure exactly when the news pipeline is down.
stale_bar_refusal: v3: at decision time for session t, the base's holdings for t are weighted at the last close before t; if more than STALE_REFUSE_SHARE of that weight sits on names whose newest bar (as of the session before t) is more than STALE_BAR_SESSIONS sessions old, the decision is REFUSED: scalar 1.0, degradation STALE_BASE_BARS, holdings named (v2 only flagged this)
stale_panel_refusal: the forward step REFUSES (STALE_PANEL) when the bars panel's last bar is not the XNYS session before the decision session, and (DRAW_ROW_MISSING) when the draw date is before the session but has no bar row; on the draw date itself the target is equal weight filled at that close, by definition
survivorship: prices_2025_26/bars.parquet was built from a universe file dated 2026-09-01: it keeps names that stopped trading after that date (24 symbols have a last bar before the panel's end, 23 of them between 2026-09-01 and 2026-11-01; KVUE's last bar is 2026-10-30), so the 2026-09 .. 2026-11 draws are NOT survivor-filtered beyond the one session between the membership date and the first draw. A panel rebuilt with a LATER membership date would survivor-filter every earlier draw: a rebuild changes the pool hash and the recorded-draw check refuses.
timing: session t = an XNYS session dated in America/New_York; decision time = min(DECISION_ET, the session's real close - 30 min) on t; read only digests stamped strictly before it; newest older than MAX_AGE_HOURS -> STALE; fill = close of t (the next close after the digest's own stamp); the scalar earns close t -> close t+1. The forward step runs only inside STEP_WINDOW_ET on a real session (refused otherwise); a --date other than today's ET session is BACKDATED and never graded; one FORWARD row per session (a repeat is a no-op)
twin: the base book at scalar 1.0: identical names, relative weights, re-target moments and cost rate; only the scalar differs
why_random_base: Why a random liquid base and not a strategy book: CH-11 (2026-11-12) found the strategy books are mostly ONE bet (momentum and revision-flow correlate 0.95-0.99; overlap 54-84%) and that the volatility band explains much of their results. An overlay on one of them would mix the scalar with that bet. A random draw from the liquid ($50M+/day) band holds no selection, so the one thing this book tests is HOW MUCH is held. A random liquid book is not a strategy, and its own return vs SPY is a property of the draw, not of the overlay.
